description:
Reusable EnvNode ESP32 core circuit including an ESP32-DevKitC and a 24AA025E48 board-identification EEPROM with factory-programmed EUI-48 identifier.

The core is powered by an externally regulated 3.3 V supply connected directly to the ESP32-DevKitC 3V3 pin. The DevKitC 5V pin remains unconnected. USB, 5V-pin and 3V3-pin power must not be applied simultaneously.

The board-identification EEPROM is connected to the EnvNode system I²C bus on GPIO21 (SDA) and GPIO22 (SCL) at address 0x50.

Intended as the reusable processor and board-identification core for externally powered EnvNode mainboards. Board-specific GPIO assignments and unused-pin handling are defined in the concrete mainboard schematic.
keywords: EnvNode ESP32 DevKitC Core Mainboard Board-ID EEPROM EUI-48 I2C 24AA025E48 external 3.3V supply reusable design block
